[EN] I've gone over my records, and the name does not appear. You have the wrong bank.
[ES] He revisado mis registros y el nombre no aparece. Te equivocaste de banco.

[EN] You want us to hold onto something for you, friend?
[ES] ¿Quieres que te guardemos algo, amigo?

[EN] Do you have something in our vaults, friend? Or did you want to put something there?
[ES] ¿Tienes algo en nuestras bóvedas, amigo? ¿O querías guardar algo allí?

[EN] Greetings, friend. How may we serve you today?
[ES] Saludos, amigo. ¿Cómo podemos servirte hoy?

[EN] The bank is not currently open for business. We are busy building a more sophisticated form of society!
[ES] El banco no está abierto al público por el momento. ¡Estamos ocupados construyendo una forma de sociedad más sofisticada!
